notes: Built 2026-09-28: arsenal/present/targets/ui_element.py. One slide as an embeddable fragment: the 1920x1080 section markup (browser mode: box-sizing and margin resets in one style element scoped to the panel's id, connectors in the svg) inside a wrapper scaled by width/1920, so the layout survives unchanged at 400 or 1200 wide. This REPLACES the earlier reflow design (stacked records, row-to-column, dropped edges): nothing reflows and nothing is dropped; the cost is that type scales with the panel. The reflow_width param is the panel width in CSS pixels.
